title: LEAD ME, SAVIOR
author: Frank M. Davis
stanzas: Savior, lead me lest I stray, Gently lead me all the way; I am safe when by thy side, I would in thy love abide.
Thou the refuge of my soul, When life's stormy billows roll; I am safe when thou art nigh, All my hopes on thee rely.
Savior, lead me, then at last, When the storm of life is past; To the land of endless day, Where all tears are wiped away.
chorus: Lead me, lead me, Savior, lead me lest I stray; Gently down the stream of time, Lead me, Savior, all the way.
